description: Collections, starter and booster packs, unlockable Characters and Bosses, earn rules and the Clearance Level track. Everything is earned by playing; nothing costs money. Pack membership lives only here, so it can be rebalanced by moving a line; cards.json is not edited. Set unlockEverything to true to make every card, Character and Boss available with no packs. See docs/packs-and-progression-plan.md.
